description:
Recorded in Lisbon over a three-day jam session, where Branko challenged some of the most critical Lisbon based musicians to improvise over a rhytmic framework. This turned into non-stop hours of recording and later served to accumulate a repository of grooves who served as the beatprint for the album. Soma amplifies authenticity and genuine expression through collaborations with local and international talents. 

Soma is set to be released on vinyl and digitally through Enchufada on March 15th
